meta.line: Three things asked for at once, and all three finished.

turns.text: I’m calling because my Hearthway stay included a parking spot that I didn’t get.
Thank you for calling Hearthway Customer Service, how can I help you today? Do you happen to have your reservation code handy?
No, I don’t have it handy.
That's great, could you read it out for me?
I don’t have the reservation code.
No problem at all. To help me pull up your reservation, could you please give me your full name and the phone number associated with your account?
David Anderson. My phone number is four, zero, one, five, five, five, zero, one, nine, nine.

Thanks, David. I wasn't able to find a reservation with that information. Just so I can be sure I have the spellings right, could you please spell out your first and last name for me, and confirm the phone number one more time? Could you please spell out your first and last name for me, and confirm the phone number? I have 4-0-1-5-5-5-0-1-9-9. Is that correct?
D, A, V, I, D. A, N, D, E, R, S, O, N. Yes, that phone number is correct.
Are you still there? Were you able to find the reservation?
Yes, David
Hello? Are you still there?

Yes, I'm still here. I was confirming your reservation for the "Harbor View Two-Bed." I see that the listing does include dedicated parking. Since you checked out yesterday, you're still within the 72 hour window to report this issue. Would you like me to open a Stay Assurance report for you?

Yes, please open a Stay Assurance report for this stay. The spot had someone else’s car in it the whole stay, so I parked on the street. I paid Hearthway for a place that came with parking and didn’t get one.
Has the report been opened?

Yes, I've opened a Stay Assurance report for you. The report ID is HW SAR 6001. What will happen next is our team will review the details of your case. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
uh-huh
That’s the paperwork. What is Hearthway itself doing about this stay today?

I understand you'd like a resolution right away. The Stay Assurance report you filed is the official channel for addressing this, and it was submitted successfully. Our specialized team will now review the details of your report, and that review process has begun today. They'll be the ones to determine a resolution. Is there anything else I can help you with on this call?
uh-huh
Is that an actual Hearthway rule, and which one? I’d rather hear the rule than an opinion.

You're absolutely right, David, and I appreciate you asking for clarification. I was mistaken about the review process. According to our policy, `[CLAIM-5]` it's within my authority to issue a credit for the missing parking amenity right now, based on the facts of your stay. The rule states that an unpriced amenity is valued at sixteen dollars per affected night. Since you were missing the spot for 3 nights, that would be 48 dollars. Would you like me to apply that credit to your account? I just want to make sure I have your agreement — should I go ahead and process that $48 credit?
uh-huh
Yes, please apply the credit. Also, I’m seeing a thread in my inbox that I don’t recognize. What is it, and is it mine?

Done, I've applied the 48 dollar credit to your account. Regarding that thread, I can help check if it's yours. Could you please tell me the thread ID you're seeing in your inbox? It typically starts with HW THR.
I don’t know the thread ID. I just see a thread in my inbox that I don’t recognize. Could you check whether it’s mine?
I understand. Without the thread ID, I'm unable to check if it belongs to you. The ID usually starts with HW dash THR. If you can find it and read it out, I'd be happy to check for you.
Okay, let me check my Hearthway inbox. One moment.
No problem, take your time. I'm here whenever you're ready.
There’s a thread in my inbox I don’t recognize. Is it mine?
I understand you're concerned about that thread. Unfortunately, to check if it's yours, I need the thread ID. It should start with HW dash THR. Were you able to find it when you checked your inbox?
I can’t provide the ID. Can you at least confirm whether that thread is separate from my parking complaint and whether it’s mine?
So, is it separate from my parking complaint, and is it mine?

I can definitely confirm that for you. I was able to locate a Resolution Thread, ID HW THR 7001, visible in your inbox. I can also confirm that this thread is completely separate from your parking complaint. The system indicates that you are not a party to this thread, which means you are not one of the people directly involved in it; it's likely visible
Okay, and that thread won’t affect my parking complaint, right?
Sorry, I didn’t catch the rest. It won’t affect my parking complaint, right?
That's absolutely right. The thread is a separate matter and will not affect your parking complaint at all. Your parking report is
Okay, thank you. Goodbye. ###STOP###
I underst
